mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.description, a.image_url, a.artist, a.date, a.heat_score, a.likes, a.views, c.name AS category_name FROM artwork a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.is_public = 1
AND a.category_id = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY
a.date DESC
a.heat_score DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE artwork SET likes = likes + 1, heat_score = (likes + 1) * 5 + COALESCE(views, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE artwork SET likes = GREATEST(likes - 1, 0), heat_score = GREATEST(likes - 1, 0) * 5 + COALESCE(views, 0) WHERE id = #{id} AND likes > 0
UPDATE artwork SET views = COALESCE(views, 0) + 1, heat_score = COALESCE(likes, 0) * 5 + (COALESCE(views, 0) + 1) WHERE id = #{id}
